static_policy_scopes.description: Scopes that have static policy application mode

ike_authentication_type.description: IKE authentication type to use for IPsec (SecureConnect and Machine Authentication)

scope.description: Label scope that limits the workload(s)

workload_mode.description: Additional match criteria to select workload(s)

illumio_primary.description: Configure Illumio to be the primary firewall

allow_captive_portal_outbound.description: Defines whether or not to open the endpoint firewall to all outbound traffic when a captive portal scenario is discovered by the VEN

containers_inherit_host_policy_scopes.description: Workloads that match the scope will apply the policy it receives both to itself and the containers hosted by it

blocked_connection_reject_scopes.description: Scopes whose blocked connection action will be reject

loopback_interfaces_in_policy_scopes.description: Workloads that match the scope will apply policy on loopback interfaces and the loopback interface's IPs will be distributed to peers.

ip_forwarding_enabled_scopes.description: Host Workloads that match the scope will have IP forwarding enabled

rule_hit_count_enabled_scopes.description: Workloads that match the scope will have rule hit count enabled
